about_intro: A free, independent hub built by students to make IOE syllabi, notes and exam-critical information easy to find: fast, mobile-friendly and low on bandwidth.
about_mission_body: Too many students lose time hunting for the right syllabus or a reliable set of notes across scattered pages and group chats. We bring the essentials (programs, courses, syllabi, notes and official links) into one clear, searchable place.
about_sources_body: Syllabi and codes are compiled from the official IOE curriculum documents and cross-checked before publishing. The whole catalogue is maintained in the open on GitHub.
about_source_2: Campus notices and the Examination Control Division
about_disclaimer_body: This is an independent, student-run project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official service of IOE or Tribhuvan University. Always confirm exam-critical information on the official sources before relying on it.
contribute_intro: Help your juniors by sharing notes, old questions or syllabus corrections. Every contribution is credited to you.
contribute_guideline_1: Share only your own work or material you have the right to distribute.
contribute_guideline_2: Label resources clearly with subject code, type and year.
contribute_guideline_3: No solutions to ongoing assessments or copyrighted textbooks.
contribute_guideline_4: Contributions are credited to the uploader and may be moderated.
contribute_how_body: The entire catalogue lives in the open on GitHub, and courses and notes are plain MDX files. Open a pull request with your notes, or file an issue with the material attached and we'll format it for you.
contribute_share_papers_desc: Board exam papers or model questions for any course and year.
contribute_share_notes_desc: Your own handwritten or typed notes, scanned or as text.
contribute_share_fixes_desc: A unit, code, credit or mark that doesn't match the official syllabus.
contribute_share_colleges_desc: Updated contacts, seats or programs for any college.
contribute_step_prepare_desc: Gather the file or the correction, with the subject code and year.
contribute_step_send_desc: Open an issue with the material attached, or a pull request if you know MDX.
contribute_step_publish_desc: We review, format and publish it, credited to you.
